vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: LangGraph analysis agents: Prose, Narrative, Consistency, Synthesis

plan.title: Analysis Agents
plan.narrative: Implement the four LangGraph agent nodes: Prose Analyst, Narrative Analyst, Consistency Checker, and Synthesis Agent. The first three run in parallel per-chunk with retrieval context + summary hierarchy. The Synthesis Agent aggregates outputs and produces the final diagnostic report with severity ratings (strength/neutral/concern) per dimension. Genre-aware prompt framing modifies system prompts based on --genre flag. Conditional routing via --depth flag controls thoroughness. Traces: FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-16, FR-21, NFR-5.

items.title: LangGraph workflow definition
items.narrative: Define the stateful graph: ingestion -> repetition detection -> [prose + narrative + consistency] (parallel) -> synthesis. Shared state schema. Conditional edges for --depth.

items.title: Prose Analyst node
items.narrative: Evaluates repetition data (from pre-processing), sentence rhythm, show-vs-tell, dialogue naturalness, vocabulary richness. Genre-aware system prompt. FR-8.

items.title: Narrative Analyst node
items.narrative: Evaluates character arcs, pacing/tension curves, theme/motif usage, structural patterns, world-building coherence. Uses summary hierarchy for cross-chapter awareness. FR-9.

items.title: Consistency Checker node
items.narrative: Detects plot holes, timeline errors, foreshadowing issues, unresolved threads. Uses retrieval context to cross-reference across chapters. FR-10.

items.title: Synthesis Agent node
items.narrative: Combines all agent outputs. Assigns severity ratings per dimension. Generates executive summary and prioritized diagnostic feedback with cited evidence. FR-11, NFR-5.

items.title: Genre prompt framing
items.narrative: Genre-specific system prompt preambles loaded based on --genre flag. Modifies evaluation criteria without changing agent structure. FR-16.
